facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet arranged in three rows: a large hero panel at the top, three full-body view panels in the middle, and four detail panels along the bottom.

The top hero panel shows a person standing on a wet, rain-slicked elevated walkway or bridge at night, flanked by dark metal railings, with blurred city lights and a warm streetlamp glow in the background.
The middle row contains three full-body views of the same person against a dark gray background, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK.
The bottom row contains four close-up detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS, showing the person's face, jacket-collar hardware, hands, and black lace-up boots.

The person has short dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered at the back, a visible scar through the eyebrow on the viewer's left, and wears an all-black outfit including a high-collared jacket with strap and buckle details, a dark shirt, tactical trousers, and boots.
The image uses a dark, low-key palette dominated by black and charcoal, with cool blue-gray tones in the rainy hero panel and warm amber highlights from background lights.
Visible panel labels read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

card.summary: A cinematic character reference sheet for one person, combining a wide rainy-night hero shot with front, side-profile, and back turnaround views plus close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.
